title: Custom Soccer Ball Water Splashes Comforter Set, Machine Washable
description:
Inspire the soccer star in your life with this exciting Jeminise Comforter Set. Designed for young enthusiasts, this bedding fuels their passion for the game and adds a dynamic touch to any boy's room. Personalize it with a name and number for a truly special gift.

Key Features

  • Soccer Enthusiasm: Designed to inspire young soccer fans and celebrate their love for the sport.
  • Available Sizes: Offered in US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), and US King (104" x 88") to fit various bed sizes.
  • Easy to Use Bedding: Features a hidden zipper and smooth metal pull for effortless duvet insertion and removal.
  • Superior Manufacturing Process: Utilizes environmental protection techniques to ensure dye retention and prevent fading, with smooth, fine, and compact stitching for lasting enjoyment.
  • Machine Washable: Simple care; wash separately in cold water and air dry without heat for quick drying and fluffiness.
  • Included Components: This set includes a duvet cover, making it a complete bedding solution.
  • Custom Options: Personalization available with text input, allowing for custom names and numbers.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Duvet Cover Set
Material Polycotton
Fabric Type Polycotton
Pattern Soccer
Style Name Modern
Included Components Duvet Cover
Customization 1 text input
Available Sizes US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), US King (104" x 88")
Selected Size Full
Thread Count 360
Pillowcase Quantity 2
Pillowcase Length 20 inches
Pillowcase Width 20 inches
Sham Quantity 2
Care Instructions Machine Wash
